newsitem.title: USA: Construction industry to lead Mass. economy.
newsitem.headline: Construction industry to lead Mass. economy.

text.p: The Massachusetts construction industry will be on of the fastest growing segment's of the state's employment for at least the next five years DRI/McGraw-Hill chief economist Sara Johnson said Tuesday.

Speaking to business leaders in Boston about the Central Artery/Third Harbor Tunnel project, Johnson said the $10.7 billion construction project would be beneficial to the state's economy because it occurs after a four-year decline in Massachusetts construction jobs.

"The growth of construction employment over the next five years will make constuction among the fastest growing employment sectors of the state's economy," she said, adding that the project which is entering its peak phase "will more than double the number of people it employs reaching its highest point in 1999, when 6,000 people will be working on the project."
